verdict.rationale: Conductor documents its own hosted MCP server that lets ChatGPT, Claude, Codex and other MCP clients manage cloud workspaces, and a probe confirms the official MCP docs page exists. The axis applies because the product itself serves MCP. Missing for 10: details on the tool set, auth, and setup flow; coverage beyond cloud workspaces (local workspaces are not mentioned); independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Conductor's hosted Model Context Protocol (MCP) server lets ChatGPT, Claude, Codex, and other MCP clients manage your cloud workspaces.
official MCP server documented at https://www.conductor.build/docs/api/mcp
